18:1: Yisro heard — minister of Midian, Moshe’s father-in-law —
about all that Elohim had done for Moshe
that Adonoy brought Yisrael out of Egypt.
18:5: Moshe’s father-in-law, Yisro came, along with his [Moshe’s] sons, and wife, to Moshe,
to the desert where he was camped near the mountain upon which the Glory of God was revealed.
18:10: Who rescued you from the hand of Egypt, and from the hand of Pharaoh;
18:11: that Adonoy is great, and there is no god besides Him,
through which the Egyptians plotted to punish Yisrael, they themselves were punished.”
18:12: [Then] Yisro, Moshe’s father-in-law, offered a burnt-offering and [peace]-offerings before God.
Aharon and all the elders of Yisrael came to eat bread with [Yisro,] Moshe’s father-in-law, before God.
18:19: Now obey me. I will give you advice
and the Word of God will be your support.
You must ask instruction from before God for the people,
18:21: You must seek out from among all the people capable, God-fearing men, men of truth, who despise accepting gain.
You must then appoint them over [the people] as officers of thousands, officers of hundreds,
officers of fifties and officers of tens.
18:22: They shall judge the people at all times.
Every major problem they will bring to you,
and every minor problem they shall judge by themselves.
It will [thus] be easier for you
since they will bear the burden with you.
18:23: and God commands you [to do so],
you will be able to survive,
will go to their place in peace.”
18:24: and he did all that he said.
18:26: They would judge the people at all times.
The difficult problems, they would bring to Moshe,
and the simple problems they would judge by themselves.
19:3: and Adonoy called to him from the mountain, saying,
“This is what you shall say to the House of Yaakov,
and tell to the Bnei Yisrael.
19:4: and [how] I transported you as if on wings of eagles,
19:5: you shall be more beloved before Me than all the peoples,
for all the earth is Mine.
19:6: You will be before Me kings and kohanim, and a holy nation.’
the words that you shall speak to the Bnei Yisrael.”
19:8: All the people responded in unison, and said,
“All that Adonoy has spoke, we will do.”
Moshe brought the words of the people before Adonoy.
19:9: Adonoy said to Moshe, “Behold, I will become revealed to you in a thick cloud,
so that the people will hear when I speak to you,
and they will also believe in you forever.”
Moshe told the words of the people before Adonoy.
19:11: Let them be ready for the third day,
for on the third day, Adonoy will become revealed on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
19:14: Moshe went down from the mountain to the people.
19:17: Moshe brought the people toward the Word of God, [leading them] out of the camp.
They stood at the foot of the mountain.
19:18: The entire Mount Sinai was enveloped with smoke,
for Adonoy had become revealed upon it in fire.
Its smoke rose like the smoke of a [lime] furnace
and the entire mountain trembled violently.
19:19: and from before God he was answered with [His] voice.
19:20: Adonoy became revealed on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain,
and Adonoy called to Moshe to come up to the top of the mountain, and Moshe went up.
19:21: lest they break through [the boundary] before Adonoy in order to see;
19:22: Even the kohanim who [usually] come near to serve before Adonoy, must be sanctified,
19:23: for You have warned us saying,
‘Set a boundary around the mountain and sanctify it.’”
19:24: You will then come up [again], along with Aharon.
The kohanim and the people, [however,] must not break through to go up before Adonoy, lest He kill them.”
20:2: Who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
20:3: You must not have any other gods besides Me.
20:5: You must not prostrate yourself to them, and you must not worship them.
For I, Adonoy your God, am a jealous Almighty.
I am cognizant of the sins of fathers for rebellious children, to the third and fourth [generations] of My enemies, when the children complete the sinning after their fathers.
20:6: But I do [acts of] goodness for thousands [of generations]
to those who love Me and preserve My commandments.
20:7: Do not swear in the Name of Adonoy, your God in vain.
the one who swears in His Name falsely.
20:10: You must not do any manner of work — you, your son, your daughter, your slave, your maid, your animal,
and the foreigner within your gates.
20:13: Do not steal [by kidnapping human beings].
Do not testify false testimony against your neighbor.
20:16: “You speak to us and we will obey.
Let it not be spoken to us from before Elohim lest we die.”
20:17: Moshe said to the people, “Do not be afraid.
that the Glory of Elohim became revealed to you,
so that the fear of Him be on your faces that you not sin.”
20:18: Moshe drew near to the dense cloud
20:20: Do not make[an image of anything that is] before Me,
gods of silver or gods of gold
you must not make for yourselves.
20:21: and slaughter your burnt-offerings near it, your peace-offerings,
In every place where I rest My Shechina,
there I will send my blessing to you and bless you.
20:22: When you build a stone altar before Me,
do not build it out of hewn stone,
lest you lift your sword on it, you will [therewith] have profaned it.
